acceptance_scope: Remotive implemented and verified as an independently traceable global job-source adapter under MJ-REQ-017. Declares exact capabilities (PUBLIC_JSON, DISCOVERY, JOB_DETAIL, SALARY, REMOTE_METADATA, APPLICATION_REDIRECT) and disallows unsupported features (DIRECT_APPLICATION). Normalizes multi-company jobs, salary ranges/currencies, tags into skills, and remote candidate location requirements. Integrated into source registry and collection engine with deterministic tests.
acceptance_behavior: Remotive adapter declares CollectionStrategy.PUBLIC_JSON and supported capabilities: DISCOVERY, JOB_DETAIL, SALARY, REMOTE_METADATA, APPLICATION_REDIRECT.
Unsupported features like DIRECT_APPLICATION and SCREENING_QUESTIONS raise UnsupportedFeature / ValueError according to capability contract.
Public API endpoint https://remotive.com/api/remote-jobs is searched with category/tag/limit/search parameters.
Per-job multi-company attribution is preserved using SourceCompany with identity parts ('remotive', company_slug).
Skills, remote metadata (remote status, candidate required location), employment type, and salary bounds/currency are normalized to canonical search semantics.
Adapter handles transport errors, rate limiting 429 backoff headers, timeout budgets, and updates source health accurately.
Registry source_adapter recognizes provider 'remotive' and configure_source supports 'remotive' providers.
